name: gizza-ai/xlsx-sheet-diff
summary: Compare two spreadsheet sheets cell-by-cell (value, formula, structural diffs)

tool.description: Compare two worksheets of a spreadsheet (.xlsx, .xlsm, .xls, or .ods) cell-by-cell and report value changes, formula changes, and structural (added/removed row and column) differences. Provide the workbook via url (a public http/https link) or ref (an uploaded attachment id), and pick the two sheets by name or 0-based index (defaults to the first two). Output as a readable table, structured JSON, or a flat CSV change-log.

compare_formulas.description: Also compare stored formula strings, so a rewritten formula is caught even when its cached result is unchanged.

format.description: Output: table (readable report), json (structured report), or csv (flat change-log, one row per changed cell).

ignore_case.description: Compare cell and formula text case-insensitively (original text is still shown).

ignore_whitespace.description: Collapse runs of whitespace before comparing (original text is still shown).

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

sheet1.description: First worksheet to compare: a sheet name, or a 0-based index as a string (e.g. "0"). Defaults to the first sheet.

sheet2.description: Second worksheet to compare: a sheet name, or a 0-based index as a string (e.g. "1"). Defaults to the second sheet.

url.description: Document URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
